High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[General Walex Blissex (V)]] (Virtual Set 9, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 9/Light/General Walex Blissex.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1f2i4Dren_J24d93_RjCRlCBduUj2JO3I/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>General Walex Blissex.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,456 bytes, SHA-256 <code>3748e1ee36af30569dcb440c7c8fa327f200e819f709b48bea6479fd055aa727</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V9-L-generalwalexblissex-2018-07-08.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
